summary: Default CLI semantic pipelines to LLM-first

delivery.outcome: CLI pipeline and watch invoke audited task-synthesis LLM by default while retaining explicit fail-closed modes and the established complete offline profile
nonGoals: No programmatic service or PipelineOptions default change
No model, prompt, schema or provider change
No dependency or public option-shape change

architecture.decision: Resolve omitted CLI task mode to require-llm except when the caller already selected the complete explicit offline profile; explicit task modes always win
architecture.rollback: Restore the omitted task-mode default to disabled and remove the focused regression; explicit modes are unchanged

validation.evidence: Omitted task mode fails at required LLM task synthesis without a provider
Explicit disabled mode keeps the watch fixture offline
Full host, governance and Docker checks pass
